Chapter 6033: Bring This Back

Chapter 6033: Bring This Back

As Omni wailed in agony, his dao fruits and anima tree perished under the might of Unrivalled Monarch.

His screams echoed across Splendor Terra and broke the invaders’ courage. A half-step emperor had just fallen, no longer existing in this world.

The members of Splendor found her presence to be the greatest cure for their fear and anxiety. As long as she was around, so would Splendor Terra.

“Bam!” Allmountain was sent flying, still unable to keep up. He vomited a mouthful of blood due to a serious injury.

Everyone could see who had the upper hand after the exchange. Allmountain ranked third in Immortal Suppression, the two stronger emperors being Tranquility and Transcendent.

Allmountain turned pale and immediately disappeared into the horizon, crossing through the dimensions without saying another word. Unrivalled couldn’t catch up even if she wanted to due to the speed of an emperor at the origin stage.

“Clank.” She pinned her spear on the ground and increased the pressure.

True to her title, she had no rival in both appearance and regality. Her lithe figure bathed in sunlight amazed spectators and left them in awe.

There were many peerless cultivators in this world and she was one of them. Just one glance was enough to create an everlasting memory.

“Kill them all.” She gave the order.

“Go!” Greatsword, Smoke Fiend, Goldvase, and other leaders started their counterattack.

“Run!” Experts and ancestors from the coalition regained their wits and ran with haste; their battle spirit was destroyed.

“Don’t let them get away!” Members of Splendor roared furiously like tigers descending from the mountain. They closed the gate to Splendor Terra and activated sky barriers, preventing escape routes. This was the time to make the enemies pay with blood.

Just a moment ago, they lost brothers and friends, nearly facing sect destruction. The return of Unrivalled Monarch turned the tide, and they did not intend to show mercy.

“Ahh!” The other side had no leaders or morale to speak of, being routed in no time at all. This was a fight between tigers and sheep.

Some great powers brought legions but without capable commanders and under the pressure of Unrivalled Monarch, they couldn’t stand their ground against the frenzied horde of Splendor Terra.

Only a few ancestors and sect leaders successfully escaped, the rest fell in battle. The stench of blood permeated the region; mountains of corpses could be seen among the ravaged land.

Nevertheless, the lucky survivors were in high spirits after winning the battle. They could still rebuild their home and stand tall in Sin.

As for Unrivalled Monarch, she landed on the immortal palace and gazed at the aftermath. As her members cleaned up the battlefield, Li Qiye also came out.

“Young Noble.” She bowed deeply and said: “We don’t know how we can ever repay you, just say the word in the future and we shall obey.”

Li Qiye smiled and gestured for Sky Step King to come closer.

“Young Noble.” He approached and bowed.

Li Qiye summoned the statue and placed it on his back.

“Take this, how much you get out of it depends on you.” Li Qiye said.

Sky Step shuddered because despite not knowing what it was, the eye’s ability was special. This couldn’t be inferior to any of the six immortal treasures. This was a gift others could only dream about.

“Thank you for your generosity, Young Noble, I am truly grateful.” He bowed repeatedly.

Li Qiye waved and said: “Go, be a better person and your future will be bright.”

Sky Step bowed again before respectfully bidding goodbye to Unrivalled Monarch’s group and leaving with the statue.

Everyone understood the statue's value but since Li Qiye had given it away and Unrivalled Monarch agreed implicitly, no one said anything.

“Take this back.” Li Qiye smiled and took off a ring, tossing it to Unrivalled Monarch.

“Young Noble!” She knew this ring contained the main treasuries of Splendor and was symbolic.

“You’re alive, so it should return to its owner.” Li Qiye smiled.
